title: Renormalised solutions to reaction-diffusion systems with interface conditions: Global existence and weak-strong uniqueness
summary: We introduce an extension of the concept of renormalised solutions for entropy-dissipating reaction-diffusion systems due to J. Fischer (Arch. Ration. Mech. Anal. 218, 2015) to systems coupled by nonlinear interface conditions. For this notion of solution, we establish global existence as well as a weak-strong stability estimate. Our framework allows to handle entropy-dissipating interfacial transmission rates without growth restrictions, including power-law nonlinearities as arising in the thermodynamic modelling of dissipative bulk-interface systems via generalised gradient structures.
